item.shamanicmounts.shamanic_saddle.hint: The only saddle a spirit mount takes. Calm a wild adult with a golden apple, use the saddle on it, then ride and answer its fifteen prompts.
item.shamanicmounts.saddle_bags.hint: Straps on under the saddle for two rows of five slots, three rows on an elk. Taking them off tips out what they held.
item.shamanicmounts.diamond_apple.hint: Feed one to each of two tame adults you own, within ten seconds and eight blocks. Any line with any other; one foal, one body.
book.shamanicmounts.tip: Your tames, their genes, and a breeding chapter you can hide.
shamanicmounts.tip.flute: Calls the mounts following you, from any distance. Mounts left on Stay or Wander stay put.
mount.shamanicmounts.ordered.follow: %s follows you, into other dimensions too
mount.shamanicmounts.no_room: %s found no room beside you and stayed behind
item.shamanicmounts.egg.hint: Hatches a wild mount of this line. Its pelt and size lean with the biome's climate, as wild herds do. Calm it with a golden apple before the saddle.
Ride a tame mount up and use the post to offer it. Another rider who uses a post on their mount swaps with you. Sneak-use to offer a gift anyone on foot can take.

book.shamanicmounts.lines.intro: Click a line for its three pelts and its founder's genes.
book.shamanicmounts.pelts.rank: Pelts: A over B over C
book.shamanicmounts.tames.empty: No tames in the book yet. Tame a wild adult with a Shamanic Saddle.
book.shamanicmounts.locus.head: head
book.shamanicmounts.rule.torso: Dominant: U > S > H > D > C > B > N. The hidden body pulls the neck, head, tail, and girth toward its own.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.head: One copy shows, picked at birth. The other is carried.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.legs: Mixed counts meet in the middle: eight with four shows the spare pair, two with four a hitched pair. None is recessive.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.foot: One copy shows, picked at birth. The head has no say.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.rack: The bigger rack shows. Over none it comes in one step smaller. Two crowns make the elk's heavy rack.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.gait: Sea shows over land. Cinder needs two copies. Sea with cinder shows mist.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.wings: Two full or two astral show whole. Full with astral shows both. Full over vestigial shows full. Any other mix shows pinions.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.wingspan: The two copies average: small x0.6, mid x1.0, large x1.6, great x2.2, vast x3.0.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.tail: One copy shows, picked at birth. A tail over none comes in as a stub.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.scale: The line's frame. Giant shows from one copy and is greater with two. Slight needs two.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.size: Size within the line. The copies average: XS x0.86, S x0.93, M x1.0, L x1.07, XL x1.14.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.coat: Bone covers every pattern. Solid over rosette shows solid. Other mixes show both.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.pelt: Dominant: A > B > C. The names follow the body that shows.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.realm: Every realm other than hearth shows, and two different realms show together.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.phase: Veil shows from one copy. Ghost needs two. Veil with ghost shows the deep veil.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.sense: Eye shows over scent. Scent needs two copies.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.bond: Drum shows from one copy. The nagual's bond needs two.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.ward: Every ward shows from one copy, and two different wards show together.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.trail: Every trail shows from one copy, and two different trails show together.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.dream: One copy flies by night. Two copies fly day and night, without hunger.
book.shamanicmounts.rule.recessive: Shows only with two copies. One copy is carried.
book.shamanicmounts.line.eightfold.blurb: Eight hooves. Walks on water and steps up a full block.
book.shamanicmounts.line.drum_hart.blurb: Use sounds the drum: Regeneration for you and friends. Night vision.
book.shamanicmounts.line.elk.blurb: Bigger saddle bags. Attack rams with strong knockback.
book.shamanicmounts.line.crane.blurb: Two riders. Hold jump to glide.
book.shamanicmounts.line.nagual.blurb: Use sends it away. You get Speed and Jump Boost meanwhile.
book.shamanicmounts.line.barghest.blurb: Hostile mobs glow through walls. Guards: gets up from a stay to fight.
book.shamanicmounts.line.roc.blurb: Hold jump to fly and climb, then glide until the bar refills.
book.shamanicmounts.line.shade.blurb: Hold sneak to hide from mobs. Sneak and use blinks forward.
book.shamanicmounts.line.bear.blurb: Attack mauls everything in front. Both copies: less damage riding.
book.shamanicmounts.line.serpent.blurb: No legs. Swims and dives. Attack coils one foe.
book.shamanicmounts.line.chimera.blurb: All ten ridden gifts at once. Hides, glides, or guards only if the cross beneath does. Bred from two mounts with every gift.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.herd.1: Ten lines of spirit mount roam the Overworld, one at a time, each in its own biomes: bears in the woods and the snow, cranes on the rivers, rocs in the mountains. Each stands at least as tall as a horse, and the serpent as long as two.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.herd.2: Where a mount is born decides its pelt: a polar bear on the snow, a black bear in the forest, a snow leopard on the slopes. The cold grows them a little larger.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.herd.3: Every mount is built from genes. Its body, head, legs, tail, pelt, size, and what it does when ridden are each passed down on their own.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.herd.4: Health, speed, jump, and stamina each run from 1 to 100. A foal takes after the stronger parent in health, speed, jump, and stamina, and can come out a little higher.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.taming.1: Wild adults attack. A golden apple makes one stop for two minutes. Food does not tame a spirit mount.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.taming.2: While it is calm, right-click with a Shamanic Saddle to put it on. A vanilla saddle does not fit.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.taming.3: Right-click again to mount. For thirty seconds it shows a direction. Press that direction with the movement keys or the arrow keys. The mount steps the other way.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.taming.4: Fifteen prompts, two seconds each. Four misses are allowed. Getting off fails the try.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.taming.5: Sneak to step off. On a mount that hides, blinks, or dives, a held sneak keeps you on; tap it to step off.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.keeping.1: Sneak and right-click a tame for its tack: the saddle, Saddle Bags, and horse armor. Foals wear none.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.keeping.2: A hurt tame eats any meat from your hand, raw or cooked, and mends by what the cut is worth. Not rotten flesh. A sound one leaves it and you climb on.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.keeping.3: A new tame follows you, and keeps following when you step off. On that screen, tell it to stay and it lies down wherever you leave it, or to wander nearby.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.keeping.4: A following mount near you goes with you into another dimension: by portal, by command, or home from the End. Ride one through and you arrive in the saddle.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.keeping.5: Your tames are listed here, loaded or not. Open one for its genes and family, to rename it, or to release it.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.book.1: Lines shows every founder and its three pelts. Key explains how genes are written.
book.shamanicmounts.basics.book.2: Breeding explains how a pair makes a foal and how each gene passes down.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.pair.1: Any two mounts can breed. Feed a Diamond Apple to one tame adult you own, then the other within ten seconds and eight blocks. One foal. Those two rest for five minutes.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.pair.2: An operator can feed them during that rest, and a mount an operator readied stays ready until the pair is made.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.pair.3: The foal is born wild and small, and grows up over twenty minutes. It keeps near the grown mounts. It wears no saddle, bags, or armor. Once grown, calm it with a golden apple and tame it from the saddle. Its parents go in this book then.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.copies.1: Every gene comes in two copies: one from the dam, one from the sire. Each parent passes one of its two at random.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.copies.2: Genes that sit together usually travel together: the body with its legs, feet, and gait; the head with build, size, pattern, and pelt; the wings with their span. About one time in eight a neighbour swaps over.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.shape.1: The body shows by rank: bear over steed over hart over hound over cat over bird over serpent.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.shape.2: The hidden body still counts. It pulls the neck, head, tail, and girth halfway toward its own shape, so a steed carrying serpent has a longer neck and tail.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.shape.3: The head, the feet, and the tail each show one copy, picked at birth. The other is carried and can come back in a foal.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.coat.1: Build is the line's frame; the elk, the roc, and the bear carry giant. Size within the line runs XS to XL, and the two copies average.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.coat.2: Pelt: A shows over B, and B over C. The third pelt of every line needs two copies. Its name follows the body that shows.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.coat.3: Wingspan averages its two copies. A roc carries a vast copy, so bred fliers can have wings three times a crane's.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.gifts.1: Each ridden gift is its own gene, and they stack on whatever body the cross made.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.gifts.2: Skin (the nagual's send-away) and veil (the blink) need both copies. One dream copy flies only at night. The shade's hide is not a gift: it needs the ghost phase from both parents. The rest show from one copy.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.chimera.1: When both parents have every gift, the foal is an even chance of the normal cross or the chimera.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.chimera.2: The chimera is the furry scaled dragon, with all ten ridden gifts at once, both copies of each: it walks on water, drums, rams, carries two, sends itself away, makes mobs glow, flies any time, blinks, mauls, and coils.
book.shamanicmounts.breeding.chimera.3: Hiding, gliding, and guarding are not gifts. They come from the ghost phase, full wings, and the guard ward, so the chimera has them only if the cross underneath does. The body genes of the cross stay underneath, and its foals inherit them.
book.shamanicmounts.key.intro.1: Every mount carries two copies of each gene. The book writes the dam's copy first, then the sire's.
book.shamanicmounts.key.intro.2: A capital letter shows. A small letter is carried: it does not show on this mount, but it can in a foal.
book.shamanicmounts.key.intro.3: Two capitals mean both copies show at once, or average.
book.shamanicmounts.key.intro.4: On a tame's page, hover a gene to see how it passes down.
